patterns.title: External provider authority under-specification
signals: provider identity not proven from governing project authority
anti_signals: provider identity explicitly named by accepted project configuration
governed provider manifest proves provider/account/environment scope
prevention_guidance: resolve authoritative provider identity before credential selection or network execution
treat discovered providers as unavailable for execution until authorized
detecting_tests: matching but unauthorized runtime manifest negative control
known_false_positives: a discovered provider that exactly matches a separately proven authoritative provider identity

patterns.title: Credential provenance under-specification
signals: credential chosen because it is available
credential scope or environment not proven
global credential reused for governed project
provider identity proven but credential source unproven
anti_signals: non-secret credential provenance proves project/provider/environment/account scope
credential source is explicitly authorized by governing project configuration
prevention_guidance: prove non-secret credential provenance before authenticated network execution
bind credential source to governed provider/project/environment/account scope
detecting_tests: wrong account or environment negative control
known_false_positives: an available credential whose provenance is independently proven for the exact governed scope
